goal: Reduce static non-GUI Linux binary sizes by roughly 0.5 MB by stripping unused standard library components
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified with reproducible Guix build hashes across architectures (hebasto)
Supported after clarifying that disabling libstdc++fs is cleanup (willcl-ark)
Unanswered suggestion to check for side effects on Boost.MultiIndex (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because reducing binary bloat provides modest benefit to release artifacts
It does not fix build failures or affect build integrity, making it safe to defer
